name: tessera-bridge
description: Mirrors Claude's questions to Tessera touch screens in Home Assistant and pushes the account's usage limits as HA sensors

haUrl.title: Home Assistant URL
haUrl.description: Base URL of Home Assistant as this PC reaches it, without a trailing slash

haToken.title: Home Assistant token
haToken.description: A long-lived access token (HA profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens). Empty turns the bridge off.

screen.title: Screen
screen.description: Device name of one Tessera screen (e.g. waveshare-p4-2), or empty for every paired screen

answerEntity.title: Answer entity
answerEntity.description: The input_text helper the screen's buttons write the answer to

soundPlayer.title: Sound player
soundPlayer.description: A media_player entity (e.g. the screen's own speaker) that plays a chime and reads the question when an alert appears, through the Chime TTS integration. Empty: no sound.

soundChime.title: Chime
soundChime.description: The Chime TTS preset played before the question (chirp, bells, ding_dong, knock, soft, ...). Empty: no chime, only the spoken text.

soundSpeak.title: Read the question aloud
soundSpeak.description: on: the question (or the permission hint) is spoken after the chime. off: chime only.

permissionHints.title: Permission hints
permissionHints.description: on: a permission prompt in the app also shows a hint alert on the screen (answered on the PC). off: no hint.
